_comment: Per-category PASSED counts (pass + flaky) of the previous accepted release gate. The gate fails a category whose passed count is below GATE_DROP_THRESHOLD (default 70 percent) of its value here, unless it was started with --allow-count-drop "<reason>". Refresh from "baseline_candidate" of a GREEN gate report after each release. Only tier L has a baseline; S and M print a warning (the count-drop check is not applied).
source: gate integ/280 @ 410903fa6 (tier L, 2026-10-19, verdict pass, 0 failed, 2 flaky; the 2.8.0 candidate). baseline_candidate = pass + flaky: preview = 11312, pixel = 188, dev = 916, fixture = 15, backend = 11213.
